c046.title: Max's new loft
c046.story: Max wanted to move out of his parents' home. A [[realtor]] showed him a [[penthouse]] on the top floor. It had a great view, but the price was crazy. Then she showed him a [[townhouse]] with its own small garden. It was nice, but a whole house was too big. Next came an apartment in a [[condominium]], but the fees were high. At last, she showed him a small [[loft]] in an old building. The [[interior]] was modern, and an old [[sofa]] stood by the window. The [[decor]] was simple, and there was a [[mini]] fridge. Max tested the [[intercom]] and the [[thermostat]]. The room was small, but Max loved its [[comfort]]. "I'll take it!" he said with a big smile.

c049.title: Cleaning day
c049.story: On Saturday, Max's apartment is a big mess. He calls a [[cleaner]], and Oksana arrives at ten. She puts all the [[plastic]] in the [[recycling]] bin. Old food goes into the [[compost]] on the balcony. She puts the leftovers in a [[container]] in the fridge. Max chooses a short [[cycle]] but adds too much [[detergent]]. Soon there are bubbles all over the bathroom floor! Oksana laughs and fills the soap [[dispenser]] with the extra soap. She changes the coffee [[filter]] and cleans the windows with a [[spray]]. Then she uses an [[aerosol]] near the kitchen fire [[alarm]]. It beeps loudly, and an [[alert]] pops up on Max's phone. They both laugh, and soon the apartment is clean and fresh.

c050.title: A weekend at the dacha
c050.story: Anna and Max visit Grandma's [[cottage]] at the dacha. Her neighbor has a small [[bungalow]], and another has a big [[villa]]. "I don't need a [[chalet]] or a palace," Grandma smiles. They drink tea on the [[veranda]], and Max sleeps in the [[hammock]]. A funny garden [[gnome]] stands next to the stone [[patio]]. In the morning, Grandma goes to the [[garden center]] for seeds. She comes back with seeds for her red [[dahlias|dahlia]]. Anna helps her plant a purple [[iris]] and a pink [[azalea]]. In the evening, the [[jasmine]] and the [[magnolia]] smell sweet. Then Anna turns on the [[sprinkler]] and gets Max all wet! He laughs and says, "Now I am a flower too!"

c051.title: Taras wants a pet
c051.story: Anna's little brother Taras really wants a pet. On Sunday, Anna takes him to the [[pet shop]]. First they look at a big [[aquarium]] with orange [[koi]]. "Are they goldfish?" Taras asks. "No, they are a kind of [[carp]]," the seller explains. Taras loves the green [[iguana]], but Anna says it is too big. Then they see three little dogs. The white puppy is calm and quiet. The seller says, "This one already has a [[microchip]]." She also says it has a gentle [[temperament]] and loves children. Taras smiles and asks, "Can we come back with Mom?"

c052.title: Games night at Grandma's
c052.story: On Friday, the family has a games night at Grandma's. Anna and Max start a big [[puzzle]] on the table. Grandpa does a [[crossword]] and asks everyone for help. Then they play [[bingo]], and Mom wins a chocolate bar. Grandma teaches Max how to play [[mahjong]]. Later Grandpa plays chess with Max and starts with a clever [[gambit]]. Max fights hard, but Grandpa wins the [[endgame]]. At the end, Grandma reads [[tarot]] cards for everyone. She also reads everyone's [[horoscope]] from the newspaper. Then she asks Max about his [[zodiac]] sign and smiles. "Max will win next Friday!" she says.
